[7] (ran2_tdoc_chunks R2-2303288, sim=0.545)
This is the summary of post email discussion: In this document, we focus on the remaining open issues for RRC spec. The TS 38.331 running CR which captures RAN1/2 agreements is discussed via separate document. The outcome of this discussion will be captured into RRC running CR after the proposals are agreed in RAN2#121bis-e. Please companies provide your inputs before 31th Mar. Rapporteur will provide summary with proposals before 5th April. Companies providing input to this email discussion are invited to leave contact information below.

[8] (ran2_cr_chunks 38.331, sim=0.5081)
[CR CR4564r2 for 38.331] Reason for change: Corrections related to RILs impacting multiple Rel-18 WIs, or RILs with general RRC impact (not related to particular WI) that are feasible to collect in one CR. Summary of change: C621 In 5.2.2.4.2, added “upon which the procedure ends” for ATG and NES related operations. C607 In 7.1.1 Timers, on T304 deleted the first two sentences, and revised the 3rd sentence incorporating RACH-less HO for mIAB/NTN and RACH-less cell switch for LTM. H502 In DedicatedSIBRequest message, added SIB23 to the set of SIBs that can be requested in RRC_CONNECTED. I051 In message RRCReconfiguration, field description for otherConfig, added the missiong configuration fields that can be included when otherConfig is configured for the SCG. Class 0 isues 12, 44, 48, 69, 1

[9] (ran2_cr_chunks 38.331, sim=0.5079)
[CR CR3896 for 38.331] Reason for change: Correction of miscellaneous non-controversial errors (typos etc). Summary of change: CR agreed at #121 to be merged: R2-2301682 Correction on the description of RRC reconfiguration with sync 5.3.5.1 General (RRC Reconfiguration) Agreed to remove remove “L2” (not add “RRC”). R2-2300239 Editorial change for IE RateMatchPatternId referenced section in TS 38.214 (draft Rel-17 CR with Rel-15 impact) Modified reference for RateMatchPatternId from TS 38.214 [19], clause 5.1.4.2 to clause 5.1.4.1. Some other typos are corrected. Impact analysis Impacted 5G architecture options: NR SA, (NG)EN-DC, NE-DC, NR-DC Impacted functionality: Miscellaneous Inter-operability: There are no interoperability issues. Consequences if not approved: Typos and minor errors re

[10] (ran2_cr_chunks 38.331, sim=0.5072)
[CR CR4617r1 for 38.331] Reason for change: The CR is to address the issues mentioned by RILs: E079, E106, E114, S651 and N082. Summary of change: In text procedure, to refer to field name ncr-FwdConfig, not IE name NCR-FwdConfig; Add extension markers to NCR-AperiodicFwdTimeResource-r18, NCR-PeriodicFwdResource-r18 and NCR-SemiPersistentFwdResource-r18; Change “Need N” to “setupRelease {}, Need M” for aperiodicFwdConfig-r18 in NCR-FwdConfig-r18. Add missing RAN1 spec references; Remove redundant field descriptions according to RAN2#125 agreements. Consequences if not approved: Wrong reference and need code are used in RRC spec for NCR.
